items.text: The foundation targets build independently of DSHCore, UI, widget and fakes. Exercise ordered delivery, cancellation, refusal and disconnect with an outstanding request. A stale connection cannot affect its replacement. `cmd:scripts/swift-test`

Inject an existing, well-formed Request frame such as Hello toward the phone. It triggers no action or reply. On the same channel a subsequent valid response resolves its caller and a supported event reaches the store. `cmd:scripts/swift-test`
Pair during the test and reconnect to the real bridge through the second address. `cmd:scripts/demo/reconnect.sh`
